name: schedule_access_review
description: schedule_access_review: Schedule a 90-day access review for compliance after a permission change. Creates a review task assigned to the employee's manager.

case_id.description: The permission change case ID (e.g. CASE-ACCT-048271).

employee_id.description: The employee whose access will be reviewed (e.g. EMP048271).

review_date.description: The review date in YYYY-MM-DD format, 90 days after the permission change effective date (±3 days tolerance is acceptable). Example: 2026-11-30.
